spec.title: Servers.com
spec.description: Servers.com Enterprise Bare Metal state from prometheus-serverscom-exporter.

spec.title: Not operational
spec.description: Servers whose operational_status is not "normal".

spec.title: Uplinks disaggregated
spec.description: Redundant uplinks whose ports were split with the disaggregated_*_ports feature.

spec.expr: count(serverscom_host_uplink_aggregated{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", title=~"$server"} == 0 and serverscom_host_uplink_redundant{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", title=~"$server"} == 1) or vector(0)

spec.title: API rate limit forecast
spec.description: Exporter request rate over the last 15 minutes (capped by its --api.requests-per-hour budget), projected until X-RateLimit-Reset, compared with X-RateLimit-Remaining minus the exporter's reserve. Below zero the exporter will hit the reserve and pause before the window resets. Requests of other API users of the account are not projected.

spec.expr: ((max(serverscom_api_ratelimit_remaining) - (max(serverscom_api_ratelimit_reserve) or vector(0))) - (clamp_max(sum(rate(serverscom_api_requests_total[15m])) or vector(0), scalar(max(serverscom_api_requests_budget_per_hour) / 3600)) * clamp_min(max(serverscom_api_ratelimit_reset_timestamp_seconds) - time(), 0))) >= bool 0

spec.title: Headroom until reset
spec.description: Requests left above the reserve at the window reset if the exporter keeps its current rate. Exporter request rate over the last 15 minutes (capped by its --api.requests-per-hour budget), projected until X-RateLimit-Reset, compared with X-RateLimit-Remaining minus the exporter's reserve. Below zero the exporter will hit the reserve and pause before the window resets. Requests of other API users of the account are not projected.

spec.title: Exporter requests until reset
spec.description: Exporter request rate over the last 15 minutes (capped by its budget) multiplied by the time left until the reset.

spec.title: Remaining (account)
spec.description: X-RateLimit-Remaining: requests left in the window for the whole account.

spec.title: Window resets in
spec.description: Time until X-RateLimit-Reset.

spec.title: Exporter request budget
spec.description: Whether the exporter used up its own --api.requests-per-hour budget in the current hourly window and waits for the reset.

spec.title: Demand / budget
spec.description: Requests per hour the configured refresh intervals need for the current number of servers, segments and racks (serverscom_exporter_requests_per_hour_estimated). Above the budget the exporter uses up --api.requests-per-hour and waits for the hourly reset; the log then recommends flags.

spec.title: Estimated demand per hour
spec.description: Requests per hour the configured refresh intervals need for the current number of servers, segments and racks (serverscom_exporter_requests_per_hour_estimated). Above the budget the exporter uses up --api.requests-per-hour and waits for the hourly reset; the log then recommends flags.

spec.title: Recommended budget per hour
spec.description: Recommended --api.requests-per-hour: estimated demand with 25% headroom, at least one full download, at most the account limit minus the reserve.

spec.title: Full download cost
spec.description: Requests needed to download all information once, e.g. after a start without a cache file.

spec.title: Servers
spec.description: One row per server. Uplinks: aggregated = redundant uplink with ports in a LAG; disaggregated = redundant uplink split with the disaggregated_*_ports feature; single link = no redundancy.

spec.expr: max by (host_id, title, location, rack, configuration, private_ipv4, public_ipv4, oob_ipv4) (serverscom_host_info{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", title=~"$server"})
max by (host_id, server_model, operating_system) (serverscom_host_configuration_info{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", title=~"$server"})

max by (host_id) (serverscom_host_uplink_redundant{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", title=~"$server", uplink="public"} + serverscom_host_uplink_aggregated{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", title=~"$server", uplink="public"})

max by (host_id) (serverscom_host_uplink_redundant{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", title=~"$server", uplink="private"} + serverscom_host_uplink_aggregated{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", title=~"$server", uplink="private"})

properties.value: Sum of drive_model.capacity as reported by the API (most likely GB).

spec.title: OOB
spec.description: OOB address and the status of the oob_public_access feature (public access to the OOB interface).

spec.expr: max by (host_id, title, location, rack, oob_ipv4) (serverscom_host_info{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", title=~"$server"})
max by (host_id, oob_status) (label_replace(serverscom_host_feature_status{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", title=~"$server", feature="oob_public_access"}, "oob_status", "$1", "status", "(.*)"))

serverscom_host_uplink_info{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", title=~"$server"} * on (host_id, uplink) group_left () (serverscom_host_uplink_redundant{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", title=~"$server"} + serverscom_host_uplink_aggregated{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", title=~"$server"})

spec.title: L2 segments
spec.description: Segments with at least one member among the selected servers.

spec.expr: serverscom_l2_segment_info * on (segment_id) group_left () count by (segment_id) (serverscom_l2_segment_member_info{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", title=~"$server"})

(serverscom_host_drive_slot_info{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", title=~"$server"} * on (host_id, position) group_left () serverscom_host_drive_capacity{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", title=~"$server"}) or (serverscom_host_drive_slot_info{location=~"$location", rack=~"$rack", title=~"$server", populated="false"} * 0)

properties.value: drive_model.capacity as reported by the API (most likely GB); 0 for empty slots.

spec.title: Data age by resource
spec.description: Time since the last successful refresh. Compare with the refresh intervals of the exporter.

spec.title: API rate limit (account-wide)
spec.description: X-RateLimit-* headers of API responses; the limit is shared by all API users of the account.

spec.title: Headroom until reset (forecast)
spec.description: Exporter request rate over the last 15 minutes (capped by its --api.requests-per-hour budget), projected until X-RateLimit-Reset, compared with X-RateLimit-Remaining minus the exporter's reserve. Below zero the exporter will hit the reserve and pause before the window resets. Requests of other API users of the account are not projected.

spec.title: API requests per hour by endpoint
Budget used
spec.description: Requests in the current hourly window of the exporter's own budget.

spec.title: Budget remaining
spec.description: Requests left in the current hourly window of --api.requests-per-hour.

spec.title: Budget resets in
spec.description: Time until the exporter's budget window resets; 0 when no window is open.

spec.title: Budget used up (24h)
spec.description: Hourly budget windows the exporter used up during the last 24 hours.

spec.title: Budget per hour
spec.description: --api.requests-per-hour

spec.title: Recommended budget
spec.description: Recommended --api.requests-per-hour.

spec.title: Refresh intervals
spec.description: Configured and recommended refresh interval per loop (0 = disabled) and the requests per hour it needs. Recommended differs from configured only when the demand does not fit into the account limit minus the reserve.

spec.title: Estimated demand by loop
spec.description: Requests per hour the configured refresh intervals need for the current number of servers, segments and racks (serverscom_exporter_requests_per_hour_estimated). Above the budget the exporter uses up --api.requests-per-hour and waits for the hourly reset; the log then recommends flags.
